violations.description: Hardcoded API key in workflow environment block.
violations.recommendation: Use GitHub Secrets instead of hardcoding credentials in workflow files.

violations.description: Missing permissions block on workflow triggered by pull_request_target.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/auto-label.yml is triggered by pull_request_target but lacks a explicit permissions block, defaulting to broader-than-necessary permissions.
violations.recommendation: Add a permissions: block to explicitly define the minimum required permissions (e.g., contents: read).

violations.description: Untrusted pull request data used to checkout code with pull_request_target.
violations.recommendation: Do not checkout head.ref with pull_request_target as it allows arbitrary code execution from forks. Use pull_request event if checkout of untrusted code is required.

violations.description: Untrusted input from pull request title/user interpolated directly into shell command.
violations.recommendation: Avoid direct interpolation of untrusted input into shell scripts. Sanitize input or use action inputs that are safer.

violations.evidence: package.json exists but no package-lock.json or equivalent found in the repository.
violations.recommendation: Generate and commit a lockfile (package-lock.json) to ensure reproducible builds.
